trails.name: Knuckles Mountain Range
trails.description: The Knuckles Mountain Range is a UNESCO World Heritage Site with diverse flora and fauna. This trail traverses the central ridge with stunning panoramic views over the misty valleys. The terrain is moderately challenging with steep ascents and rocky sections.
trails.route_status: DEMO – coordinates are approximate reference points only

trails.name: Adam's Peak (Sri Pada)
trails.description: Adam's Peak is one of Sri Lanka's most sacred mountains, revered by Buddhists, Hindus, Muslims, and Christians. The pilgrims' path ascends 5,200 steps to the summit at 2,243 m. The climb is strenuous but the sunrise from the top is unforgettable.
trails.route_status: DEMO – coordinates are approximate reference points only

trails.name: Horton Plains – World's End Loop
trails.description: Horton Plains National Park sits at 2,100–2,300 m and offers a unique cloud forest ecosystem. The World's End trail leads to dramatic escarpments with sheer drops of nearly 900 m. Baker's Falls is a highlight along the way.
